{{Quote|We just got a warnin' from one o'our leaders that teh Imperials, Rebels, an' Neutral pilot guilds hav' been recruitin' news members. What does this mean for us? More loot!|Po "Big Guns" Mc'annon|<ref name="SWG:NoW">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Notice of Warning}}</ref>}}
'''Po "Big Guns" Mc'annon''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As the war escalated following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], as well as neutral groups, recruited a large number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Po Mc'annon and other fellow pirates, including [[Vsin Starbomber]], organized a contest to shoot down and loot the new pilots.<ref name="SWG:NoW" />
